EmailTemplate.name: Blood Booster_Thank You Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Thank You Blood Booster Partner
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear <BPL Name>,
I want to personally thank you for helping the American Red Cross connect blood donors to drives in your area. Your support plays an important role in providing the convenience donors need and the efficiency we need to serve our mission.
Thanks to your help in filling our blood drives as a Blood Booster, more patients receive the lifesaving blood they need. Your selfless contribution is greatly appreciated!
Sincerely,
<Account Representative Name> <Contact Info>
